Broad blue splash/sheet spreads along the lower channel while the orange region remains visible; no gross wall penetration or explosive cloud is apparent.
Blue fluid forms a broad bounded wave/pool around the receiver and tray; the event remains continuous.
Free surface continues redistribution across the channel, with the orange region tilted and full tank framed.
Broad contained surface pattern remains; no obvious explosive divergence, severe wall escape, or blank product is visible.
Late redistribution continues with orange region and channel outline visible; no obvious premature termination.
Final frame remains populated and fully framed; blue fluid remains visible in the tray/channel and orange region remains present, with no gross scene loss or explosive cloud.

observations.mechanism: The images support a qualitative rotated/open-rim release followed by early splash/impact, free-surface spread, and later bounded redistribution. This is an image-level mechanism description, not a numerical correctness or conservation claim.
